# Published-small Metal classifier pause probe v1

Prepared only. No model execution is represented by this directory until the explicit command produces its own process and validation receipts. Ordinary production constructor, pinned original small artifact and actual tokenizer; no test-only seam or synthetic initial adapter injection.

The five authored rows and all source/task/training options match the qualified CPU run. This probe changes execution to resident Metal and explicitly declares host128MiB, backend1GiB (including64MiB host metadata), combined2GiB. Dataset, source, job, transfer, primitive, tape and token caps are unchanged. The first call pauses after one active microbatch, before an optimizer update or inactive batch. A pass proves this narrow forward/VJP, accumulation and durable checkpoint path only.

Static resource analysis is in preparation.json. Initialization upper bound is559,322,748B for LoRA and559,335,052B for DoRA. Full compiled graph admission remains mandatory. Combined declared reservations lie between1,667,062,866B plus the tiny source struct/alignment and1,765,801,984B using the source ceiling. The historical601,295,421B live physical capacity could not admit this profile; guards and reserve remain unchanged. No current physical capacity is inferred.

The outer supervisor's3GiB cap measures sampled child-tree RSS, which can count shared pages repeatedly. It is separate from the2GiB production allocation ceiling. Exact copied supervisor a937... retains its inspected creation-identity ownership, parent/worker loss handling,35s cooperative grace,10s forced cleanup,4MiB each output and1,890s outer deadline. Its eight prior real tiny-process lifetime tests are inherited by identical bytes; this new preparation adds six pure contract tests and does not rerun models or processes.

First explicit root-owned command:

```sh
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /private/tmp/antfly-gliner25-oracle-venv/bin/python /private/tmp/antfly-gliner25-training-inactive-published-small-metal-v1/metal_pause.py run --mode lora
```

DoRA uses the same command with `--mode dora`, as a separate authorized invocation. There is no retry or overwrite. Config, source, actual binary and helper identities are checked before/after; failed process/cleanup evidence persists. The executable is fixed at `/private/tmp/antfly-gliner25-runtime-inactive-metal-v1/bin/antfly-inference`, SHA2569f0d349efa3f33dd29b6c3dd26a12a8bcf2babf2bc78400c2b84d87d58d786f9.

Offline verification takes a new evidence path and never executes or replaces the original process:

```sh
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /private/tmp/antfly-gliner25-oracle-venv/bin/python /private/tmp/antfly-gliner25-training-inactive-published-small-metal-v1/metal_pause.py validate --mode lora --output /private/tmp/antfly-gliner25-training-inactive-published-small-metal-v1/lora-offline-v1.json
```
